_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Mwena uli na kusebanya Klondike Solitaire. Mulengo wako ni kuyamisha kadi zote ku kashana kwa mpangilio.

Mikwamo ya Mchezo:
- Kashana kwa mpangilio (F1-F4): Kuyenga kwa kadi kutoka Ace hadi King kwa rangi
- Kashana kwa kusebanya (T1-T7): Kuyenga kwa kadi kwa kubadilishana rangi (nyekundu pa sumu, sumu pa nyekundu)
- Sitokwe: Kuyamisha kadi ku kashana kwa kusebanya
- Kashana kwa kusebanya (W): Kadi ya juu ikapatikana kwa kusebanya

Maagizo:
- 'draw' - Yengula kadi kutoka sitokwe ku kashana kwa kusebanya
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Yamisha kadi kati ya kashana
  Mifano: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. count inaweza kuwa 'all', ambayo itakusudia kuyamisha kadi zote zilizo wazi.
- 'forfeit' - Maliza mchezo mara moja na kubana alama yako ya sasa
- Majina ya kashana: W (kashana kwa kusebanya), F1-F4 (kashana kwa mpangilio), T1-T7 (kashana kwa kusebanya)

Ungaweza kutekeleza vitendo vingi kwa zamu moja kwa kuvitenganisha na vidoti:
  Mfano: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Ni Mafumu pekee angawamika pa kashana kwa kusebanya kwa kubadilishana.
Vitendo vinafanya kwa mpangilio - ukishindwa kimoja, vitendo vilivyosalia vitapuuzwa.
Tumia 'forfeit' ukiamini kwamba mchezo hauwezekani kushinda.

format_error.no_brackets: Ifya kucita fyalibipa. Fyonse fifwile ukuba mu makola (brackets).
format_error.no_closing_bracket: Ifyakupilibula fyafye. ']' talimo mu capinda ca kushininkisha pa kuti bapwishe ukulembapo ""
format_error.move_needs_args: Ifunde lya 'move' lifwaya intulo ne cifulo uko baleya. Ukubomfya: "move <source> <destination> [count]"

action_result.before_failure: Ukubombako imilimo ya {n} (s) ilyo tabalafilwa ukubomba.

move_result.drew: Bafumishe card (s) ku stock no kuyabaila.
move_result.cannot_draw: Te kuti tufumyepo, fyonse fibili fyali fye.
move_result.invalid_pile: Ishina lya cikota talicilolele. Ulebomfya W, F1-F4, nelyo T1-T7
move_result.foundation_one_card: Kuti wasenda fye kardi imo pa cipuna ca kukosapo.
move_result.waste_to_foundation_ok: Ukufumya ifisoso mu cikoti no kufitwala ku cifulo ca kubikamo F{dst}
move_result.waste_to_foundation_bad: Teti mufumyepo card ku cisankano ca cipampamikwa.
move_result.tableau_to_foundation_ok: Iligeuza kadi kutoka tableau T{src} hadi foundation F{dst}
move_result.tableau_to_foundation_bad: Tekuti ukule icikope ca tableau ku mulundo wa cishinte.
move_result.foundation_to_foundation: Tekuti bafumyepo pa cishinte cimo no kuya naco ku cishibi cimbi.
move_result.waste_to_tableau_one_card: Kuti wasenda fye kardi imo ukufuma ku fyabula ukubomfya ukuya pa tebulo.
move_result.waste_to_tableau_ok: Ukufumya card mu fikoti ukuya pa table T{dst}
move_result.waste_to_tableau_bad: Tekuti mubike card ya busaka pali tableau pile iyo.
move_result.tableau_to_tableau_ok: Iligeuza {count} kadi(s) kutoka tableau T{src} hadi T{dst}
move_result.tableau_to_tableau_bad: Haiwezekani kuhamisha kadi {count} kutoka T{src} hadi T{dst}
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_one_card: Kuti wasenda fye kardi imo ukufuma pa nshi ukuya ku cipinda ca mu kati.
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_ok: Iligeuza kadi kutoka foundation F{src} hadi tableau T{dst}
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_bad: Kuti mwabika card ya foundation pa tableau T{dst}
move_result.to_waste_or_stock: Te kuti bacitamfye ku fikoti nelyo ukubikamo ifintu fimbi.

outcome.forfeit: Ukuteya kwalipwa. Ama point ya kulekeleshako: {score} ama card mu ma foundation.
outcome.won: Mwabomba bwino, mwalicimfya mu Klondike Solitaire!
outcome.turn_limit: Mchezo umemalizika! Umefikia kiwango cha juu cha {max_turns} zamu. Alama: {score} kadi katika msingi.
